scope: All automatically eligible splice windows and events must have no exact coordinate entry in either searched processed normal-reference catalog, across all resolvable gene assignments and both strands.
catalog_match_including_zero_counts: REVIEW; a catalog match is not ND, even if its recorded sample counts are all zero.
unresolved_coordinates: REVIEW; unresolved coordinates cannot qualify as ND.
tissue_mean_threshold: Retained in the original measurement policy and diagnostic counts, but a low tissue mean cannot admit a detected junction under this selection rule.
unchanged: Patient RNA reconstruction, reference-peptide exclusion, read orientation, native QC, HLA affinity admission, expression-weighted scoring and five-gene quota.
